can be controlled by package open-plc-utils-plctool. sysupgrade images can be used after initial flash with special image (not: factory). In order to avoid firmware crashes or the error "ath10k_pci 0000:00:00.0: SWBA overrun on vdev 1, skipped old beacon" which is being triggered from the 5Ghz interface radio0, disable ldpc on radio0. This must be done in /etc/config/wireless, section config wifi-device 'radio0' ... ADD: option ldpc '0' }} {{SCollapse | git • >> |
